name: Bewear

attacks.name: Superpowered Hug
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. If all of them are heads, your opponent’s Active Pokémon is Knocked Out.

flavor:
Once it accepts you as a friend, it tries to show
its affection with a hug. Letting it do that is
dangerous—it could easily shatter your bones.

pokedex.text: NO. 0760 Strong Arm Pokémon HT: 6'11" WT: 297.6 lbs.
